values./items/1/system/effect: Lab Coat, Institute Laser Pistol, Robot Repair Kit, Stimpak, Dose of Mentats, Wealth 3.
values./items/7/system/description: Developed by The Institute after the Great War, Institute lasers differ in design and function from the pre-War lasers used by other factions such as the Brotherhood of Steel. Eschewing raw power for a rapid succession of beams, these lasers can lay down a searing volley of suppressive fire.
values./items/8/system/description: Once per combat, add the Institute Laser Pistol's Fire Rate of 3 to its damage for one attack, for 6 CD total, and use Burst without spending ammunition.
values./items/9/system/description: When attacked while at least one robotic synth is in the same zone, spend 1 Luck point to increase Defense by +2 against that attack.
values./system/biography: The chief scientist directs the Institute compound and its memory-theft experiment. He despises ordinary humanity, prefers his 'perfect creations', and attempts to bargain or flee rather than fight directly.
